reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the constraint of maintaining an equiatomic, high-entropy composition while proposing a physically sound mechanism (enhanced spin–orbit coupling and local distortions) to increase coercivity, and it provides a clear, testable prediction with a well-defined baseline and falsification experiment. Hypothesis B violates the equiatomic requirement by adding ~50 at.% Pt, which would lower configurational entropy below the 1.0R threshold, and its mechanism relies on L10 ordering that is not guaranteed to be single-phase or high-entropy under the stated constraints.
